text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's performance is more
than
satisfactory, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's definitely something off with her
running.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Why am I so tired? I didn't run that hard...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd have more energy left after
that. So
this is what a 1,800-meter long
race is like...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I guess I'm not getting enough
training.
Not a problem, though!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to really buckle down and
push
myself to the limit. I'm the one
who's going to win
the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ofofofo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All three of us express confusion at the
same
time... I guess I didn't mishear it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's laugh sounds strange
again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lying! I didn't even eat anything
spicy! I
didn't have salsa, habanero
pasta, or even mapo
eggplant!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So why is my voice all hoarse again? Is it
because
I'm tired from the race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it's anything too serious,
but I decide
to have her get some tests
done just in case.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're making such a big deal out of
this. I can't
believe you made me get
tested just because my
laugh sounds off.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So what's the verdict, doctor?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Have I been laughing too much? Am I
just too
tired? Or is there a piece of red
pepper caught in
my throat?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can say for sure that your altered
voice
isn't the result of eating spicy
food.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then what's causing it to sound so
weird?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're suffering from epiglottic

entrapment.
